highlight.caption: Brand, type and the decisions behind them

blocks.text: A portfolio an interviewer closes thinking “this person knows what they’re doing”. The site itself is the main project: the brand, the code and the decisions are all on show.

The concept started as a play button and became a vinyl sleeve: music is where my path began. At first glance it is a record sliding out of its sleeve; at second glance the sleeve’s cuts form an **E** and the cut-out forms a **C**.
The name is set in Bodoni Moda, using only its true italic (no browser-made slant). The accent moved from orange to a vinyl red, to keep the brand its own.

English and Portuguese live in the URL (/en, /pt), so every page is static and indexable in both. A small proxy sends a visitor to their language from the browser’s preferences, with the quality order handled and tested.
Switching language swaps the root layout, which surfaced two lessons:

items: React removes attributes it does not own when it remounts <html>, so the saved theme is re-applied before paint;
Next.js keeps visited pages alive but hidden, state included, so transient UI state is reset when a page is hidden.

blocks.text: Case studies are JSON files with typed blocks (paragraph, list, steps), checked when the site builds. Components decide how each block looks, so writing a case study never touches the code.
Strict TypeScript, unit tests, lint and type checks on every commit and push, and CI on every change. Contrast is checked by a test in both themes, and every animation respects reduced motion.
